summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.22, Sion support affiche 51,1 % de victoires sur 1 406 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier A. Il s'en sort le mieux contre Blitzcrank. Il souffre surtout contre Alistar, Nautilus et Séraphine.
summary.en: On patch 16.22, Sion support has a 51.1% win rate over 1,406 ranked games (Emerald+), A tier. It does best against Blitzcrank. It struggles most against Alistar, Nautilus and Seraphine.
